claims.reasoning: Bateman went and got eighteen-plus in Baltimore last week playing hard every snap, and that's the kind of receiver I want stacking bodies on this bench. Goedert's banged up and not even expected to suit up, so this is just swapping a fella who can't help us Sunday for one who's shown he will. Nine dollars — a depth add, not a headline chase.

note_reply: No note from the front office this week, and that's alright — quiet weeks just mean we let our work speak. We're 0-2 but I've watched this locker room compete every down, and a team that keeps believing in each other turns that around before anybody outside it notices. Clear eyes, full hearts, we let Sunday do the talking.
